bagPolicy.summary: Large purses, backpacks and other large bags are prohibited. Medically necessary items and diaper bags may enter after a search; the guide gives no numeric bag size.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Event parking is available in the Constant Center 43rd Street and 45th Street garages; advance garage passes are encouraged and cost less than any passes still available onsite.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: For accessible pickup and drop-off, use the entrance at 45th Street and Hampton Boulevard.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food service is on the second-floor concourse; selections vary by event and all concession payments are cashless. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The accessible entrance is on 45th Street, where the north-side VIP entrance is also located. All restrooms have accessible facilities.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests who leave the arena cannot re-enter.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The Chartway Arena Box Office is at the corner of 43rd Street and Hampton Blvd. and is open Monday to Friday, 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. For lost or stolen tickets, call the box office at (757) 683-4444.

gates.summary: Doors open about one hour before most events; the VIP and accessible entrances are on the north side at 45th Street and Hampton Boulevard.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
